summary: Another player has all uses of their per-life abilities restored; not Empower, Confidence or Restoration.

effects.subject: target
effects.note: Only per-life abilities; uses of Empower, Confidence and Restoration are not restored (L1).

requirements.note: Does not function on Empower, Confidence, or Restoration.

references.name: Empower
references.note: Uses of Empower are not restored.

references.name: Confidence
references.note: Uses of Confidence are not restored.

references.name: Restoration
references.note: Uses of Restoration are not restored.
